name: morpheus-inference
description: Morpheus MoE via api.mor.org or private Uplink for Grok Bot.

MORPHEUS_ENDPOINT_MODE.title: Endpoint mode
MORPHEUS_ENDPOINT_MODE.description: public = https://api.mor.org/api/v1 ; custom = your Uplink https://<host>/v1

MORPHEUS_BASE_URL.title: Custom Uplink base URL
MORPHEUS_BASE_URL.description: Required when mode=custom. Auto-normalized to …/v1 with warn if missing (no /chat/completions suffix). Never invent /api on Uplink.

MORPHEUS_KEY_MODE.title: Key mode
MORPHEUS_KEY_MODE.description: shared = one key; per_bot = discrete slot secrets or JSON map

MORPHEUS_API_KEY.title: API key (shared)
MORPHEUS_API_KEY.description: Bearer sk-… from app.mor.org or Uplink Prompt/ephemeral. Never master. Secret — configure via Plugins → Configure / vault inject.

MORPHEUS_API_KEY_SERAPH.title: API key slot: seraph
MORPHEUS_API_KEY_SERAPH.description: Per-bot discrete secret for slot id seraph when key mode is per_bot.

MORPHEUS_API_KEY_GARY.title: API key slot: gary
MORPHEUS_API_KEY_GARY.description: Per-bot discrete secret for slot id gary when key mode is per_bot.

MORPHEUS_API_KEY_JOSH.title: API key slot: josh
MORPHEUS_API_KEY_JOSH.description: Per-bot discrete secret for slot id josh when key mode is per_bot.

MORPHEUS_API_KEY_TRINITY.title: API key slot: trinity
MORPHEUS_API_KEY_TRINITY.description: Per-bot discrete secret for slot id trinity when key mode is per_bot.

MORPHEUS_API_KEY_TANK.title: API key slot: tank
MORPHEUS_API_KEY_TANK.description: Per-bot discrete secret for slot id tank when key mode is per_bot.

MORPHEUS_API_KEY_PHIL.title: API key slot: phil
MORPHEUS_API_KEY_PHIL.description: Per-bot discrete secret for slot id phil when key mode is per_bot.

MORPHEUS_API_KEY_MCDUCK.title: API key slot: mcduck
MORPHEUS_API_KEY_MCDUCK.description: Per-bot discrete secret for slot id mcduck when key mode is per_bot.

MORPHEUS_API_KEYS_JSON.title: Per-bot key map (JSON escape hatch)
MORPHEUS_API_KEYS_JSON.description: Optional JSON object mapping bot slot id → sk-… when key mode is per_bot. Prefer discrete slot vars; use map when host allows one install + map.

MORPHEUS_AGENT_SLOT.title: Agent slot id
MORPHEUS_AGENT_SLOT.description: Which per_bot slot to use (lowercase config key: seraph,gary,josh,trinity,tank,phil,mcduck). Also accepts MORPHEUS_AGENT.

MORPHEUS_MODEL_DEFAULT.title: Default model id
MORPHEUS_MODEL_DEFAULT.description: Exact catalog id from GET /models (not a display name).

MORPHEUS_POLICY_CURSOR_EXCEPTION.title: Native/Cursor exception policy
MORPHEUS_POLICY_CURSOR_EXCEPTION.description: true only when operator names a Cursor/native exception for the task

MORPHEUS_POLICY_FALLBACK_ON_DOWN.title: Fallback when Morpheus down
MORPHEUS_POLICY_FALLBACK_ON_DOWN.description: true = allow native fallback on 404/502/auth/empty and must surface: Morpheus didn’t work: <reason>
